title: Orsen and the Promise
author: Tamsin Voss
blurb: Emrys Halloran, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the bakery lease runs out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
